Subject: Next step: Technical deep-dive (60–90m) — aligning roster & runbook

Thanks again for the productive discovery call today — appreciate the clear overview of CoreChain's latency targets and production constraints. As discussed, the best next step is a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive with our ML/Infra team to validate performance assumptions and walk through a preflight runbook.

Quick recap & ask:
- Goal: validate feasibility for sub-200ms 95th percentile inference for your 3k token prompts and discuss deployment: Dedicated vs Private.
- Outcomes we want: performance runbook, required infra profile, and a rough cost/latency tradeoff snapshot.

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Wed 2026-06-16 — 10:00–11:30
- Thu 2026-06-17 — 13:00–14:30
- Mon 2026-06-21 — 09:00–10:30

Required Redwood attendees I plan to bring: Marcus Lin (serving runtime), Monica Patel (platform ops / preflight runbook), Ben Carter (solutions engineer - demo lead). Please confirm which of the above slots works for your team and share the CoreChain attendees (ML lead, infra/security, product).

I've attached a one-page proposed agenda and a draft SOW we can iterate on. If you prefer, send a couple of alternate times and we'll take calendar ownership.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

Great — calendar invite sent for Thu 2026-06-17 13:00–14:30 PT (Zoom link + dial-in in the invite). I've attached a short prep checklist and the proposed agenda to the Drive folder (link below). Please share the anonymized traces and prompt set by Monday so our infra team has something to look at ahead of time.

Prep checklist (short):
- Representative prompt set (anonymized) — CSV or plaintext, 50–200 samples.
- Latency traces: aggregated P50/P95 and sample per-request logs (anonymized).
- Model variant(s) you plan to try in prod + tokenization details.
- Compliance notes: data residency/regulatory constraints (if any).

Suggested agenda (60–90):
1) 10m — quick context + success criteria (CoreChain)
2) 25–35m — runtime & memory profile deep-dive (Marcus)
3) 15–20m — preflight/runbook & deployment options (Monica)
4) 15m — demo: batching/fallbacks and cost/latency tradeoffs (Ben)
5) 10–15m — Q&A and next steps (identify pilot scope)

If anything changes on attendees or artifacts, reply here and we will adjust. Looking forward to it.
